posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: You can't turn around an image, it's not a 3d model, so no, it's not possible for a plugin to show you a clock from a side that doesn't exist. If you need furniture as seen from the side, you'll have to draw them, or get someone to draw them. Or buy a premium tileset that has them.
